banner.title: Your privacy, your choice
banner.text: Velora keeps only what it needs to work in your browser: your sign-in, language and interface settings. With your permission we'll also turn on Google Sign-In — Google then sets its own cookies. We use no analytics and no advertising.

settings.title: Cookie settings
settings.subtitle: Applies to this browser. You can change it at any time.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary
necessary.text: Keep you signed in, remember your language, theme and your choice here, and protect payments and the service from abuse. Velora can't work without them.

functional.title: Sign in with Google
functional.text: Loads Google's sign-in service so you can use your Google account. Google may set its own cookies and learn that you opened the sign-in page.

settings.none: No analytics, advertising or tracking cookies — we don't use any.
settings.policy: Full list in the Cookie policy

google.notice: Clicking turns on Google Sign-In: Google's service loads and can set its own cookies.
